column1: # Batch C semantic proof mutants: the deflate header stages and _tr_flush_block (deflate-header.py makes the
# paired edits). A dropped or loosened check must make a semantic lemma fail, not only a restatement of the code.
# Fields: NAME, TRANSLATION FILE, MUTATION, BUILD TARGET, FIRST ERROR (file:line, lemma, why it fails).
# Run on 2026-11-12 against dev 669ee0f9; all five killed.

column3: extra-field loop: pending + left > pending_buf_size becomes ... > pending_buf_size + 1
column5: deflate.c.universal-call-extra.lean:277, extra_loop exit: the rest of the field no longer fits pending_buf (pending + left ≤ size fails)

column3: gz_string_loop: pending == pending_buf_size becomes pending == pending_buf_size + 1
column5: deflate.c.universal-call-string.lean:307, str_body: no room for the next name or comment byte (pending < size fails)

column3: HCRC stage: pending + 2 > pending_buf_size becomes pending + 1 > pending_buf_size
column5: deflate.c.universal-call-hcrc.lean:277, hcrc_stage: no room for the two CRC bytes (pending + 2 ≤ size fails)

column3: _tr_flush_block: the buf != NULL test of the stored choice is dropped
column5: deflate.c.engine.flush-default.lean:78, stored branch: a NULL source (negative block_start) is no longer excluded
deflate.c.engine.flush-stored.lean:79, stored_default_room: the stored block no longer fits pending_buf
